overview_description.description: qlub is a financial technology company that provides payment and ordering systems for restaurants. It develops a system where customers in restaurants can scan a QR code to access a digital menu and pay the bill using a mobile device. The same system can also support bill splitting, tipping, and payment without requiring a separate app. The platform is mainly used in dine-in restaurants, cafes, hotels, and similar venues.
